extracted.name: Sugar syrup
extracted.description: Make our sweet, simple syrup with just two ingredients and two steps, then use it for a variety of cocktails. Store in the fridge for future party drinks
instruction_lines: Dissolve 300g caster sugar in 150ml water over a low heat.
Leave to cool and bottle for future use in cocktails. Store in the fridge.
